sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 256x192, 12 um pixel pitch, 8-14 um, NETD < 40 mK; optical: 1/2.7" CMOS
features: thermal + optical bi-spectrum camera with image fusion / picture-in-picture
thermal detector: uncooled VOx 256x192, 12 um pixel pitch, < 40 mK, 8-14 um
thermal lens 9.7 mm F1.0; optical lens 8.0 mm F1.6
temperature measurement / thermography -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/- 8 C
temperature exception alarm and dynamic fire detection
VCA perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and exit
optical IR up to 30 m and white-light supplement up to 30 m, with audible/visual (voice + strobe) alarm
audio in/out interface (3.5 mm mic/line in, line-level out), RS-485, 2 alarm in / 2 alarm out

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Thermal and optical exposed as separate channels (optical Channel 1 / thermal Channel 2).

release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD2628-10 is a thermal & optical bi-spectrum network bullet camera pairing a 256x192 uncooled VOx thermal detector (9.7 mm lens) with a 2 MP (1920x1080) optical channel, aimed at perimeter protection and early fire prevention. It offers temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C), dynamic fire detection and VCA analytics. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet DS-2TD2628-10_EA_Datasheet_20251210.pdf.
